attribution: Film titles, release years, runtimes and genre names are derived from The Movie Database (TMDB). This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB. Poster paths are deliberately absent: they are TMDB's to serve, and seeding must work with no network (FR-013).
_comment: Two invariants pull against each other here and DemoSeedFixtureLoader checks both:
FR-015 — the accounts must visibly differ: their preferred genres and eras are disjoint,
and no two of them rate the same film positively outside the designed overlap.
FR-016 — they must still agree somewhere: the four films below are rated positively by
everyone, so story 029's 'first film everyone said yes to' has an answer.
Edit the taste freely; delete the overlap and startup fails on purpose (EC-18).
Every daysAgo is relative to the moment of seeding, never a calendar date (FR-022).
